name: Mankind Pharma Ltd.
business_summary: India's fourth-largest pharma company by domestic sales with ~15.2% prescription share (Kalkine 2026-10-26): chronic and acute formulations marketed through ~15,000 field reps, plus consumer healthcare (Manforce, Prega News, Unwanted-72, Gas-O-Fast), the Bharat Serums & Vaccines (BSV) women's-health/critical-care business (acquired 2024, funded by debt) and a small export business (US ~50 launches). Promoters hold 72.6%. Q2 FY27 revenue +17% to ~Rs 3,145 cr, EBITDA margin ~30% (+300bp YoY per Upstox), PAT Rs 711-716 cr (+37-39%; the screener pack shows Rs 582 cr which may be before an exceptional line). Mcap Rs 1.03 lakh cr, P/E 43. Recent: 70% stake in Belgian CAR-T biotech ACTx for EUR 48m (Oct 2026).

exposures.mechanism: SC (2026-10-08) directed the Centre to form an expert panel to curb unethical marketing/freebies to doctors; Mankind and Zydus fell up to 3% (Moneycontrol). Mankind's field-force-driven model (~15,000 MRs, ~25% of revenue on selling costs, model assumption) is most exposed to UCPMP enforcement and trade-margin/MRP caps (SC also seeks MRP-cap discussion, 2026-10). One tightening step: -2% revenue growth and +100bp selling cost = EBITDA -4%; EV/MCap 1.05, persistence 1.0, p 0.6 -> -3.0.

evidence.note: SC asks Centre to form panel on unethical pharma marketing; Mankind, Zydus fall up to 3% (Moneycontrol 2026-10-08)

exposures.mechanism: Consumer health (8% of revenue) and acute therapies (~30%) are discretionary-sensitive: +5pp urban consumption lifts that ~38% of sales by ~2.5pp = +0.95% group sales; ~60% flow-through at 31% OPM = +1.8% EBITDA; EV/MCap 1.05, persistence 0.5 (some structural) with multiple effect -> +2.0.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: strong domestic chronic business (Business Standard 2026-10-26)

exposures.mechanism: India 90%+ of revenue; IPM grows ~8-9% nominal; +1pp real GDP adds ~0.4pp to volumes -> +0.4% sales, 70% flow-through at 31% OPM = +0.9% EBITDA; persistence 1.0 -> +1.0; plus valuation sensitivity -> +1.6.

BSV-related debt: interest Rs 88 cr/qtr (down from Rs 149 cr a year ago as deleveraging, screener.in) ~Rs 4,500 cr debt (estimate, 8%); 70% floating: +25bp = Rs 8 cr/yr = 0.2% of EBITDA; discount-rate effect on 43x P/E growth stock dominates -> -1.8.

evidence.note: Interest Rs 88 cr in Sep-26 vs Rs 149 cr Sep-25 (screener.in)

exposures.mechanism: Exports ~10% of revenue; imported RM ~8% of sales: net ~+2% x 3% = +0.06% of sales... +0.3% EBITDA; empirical +0.78 (t=0.5) similar -> +0.6.
Empirical DXY +1.80 (t=1.7) (positive). Mostly defensive-rotation correlation in a 73% promoter-held stock; model prior 0, shrunk to +1.5.

Petrochemical-linked raw materials/excipients ~22% of costs: +10% feedstock = +2.2% costs; ~60% recoverable via annual WPI-linked NLEM price hike and mix -> net 0.9% of costs = 0.6% of revenue (costs ~70%); /30% OPM = EBITDA -2.0%; persistence 0.25-0.5, EV/MCap 1.05 -> -0.8.
Chronic share (~40%) and CAR-T/ speciality entry (ACTx) support ARPU; +1 unit theme -> +1.3.
FII 9.4% (down from 10.2%); promoters 72.6%; free float small. +US$5bn -> +0.8.
